UPHYS:900.canonicalSolution: The turning point is $x_0=(E/\lambda)^{1/4}$. The action is $2\sqrt{2m}\int_0^{x_0}\sqrt{E-\lambda x^4}dx=2\sqrt{2m}E^{3/4}\lambda^{-1/4}C$. Equating this to $(n+1/2)\pi\hbar$ gives $E_n=[(n+1/2)\pi\hbar\lambda^{1/4}/(2\sqrt{2m}C)]^{4/3}$. Thus $E_n\propto(n+1/2)^{4/3}$, so spacings grow with $n$, unlike the constant harmonic-oscillator spacing. The combination scales as $\hbar^{4/3}\lambda^{1/3}m^{-2/3}$ and has energy dimensions.
